t: 苏丹吉亚特·丁·图格卢克派遣一支由他儿子穆罕默德·本·图克卢克所率领的远征军去卡卡蒂亚首都瓦朗…
te: Sultan Ghiyath al-Din Tughluq sends an expeditionary army led by his son, Muhammad bin Tughluq, to the Kakatiya capital…
dz: 瓦朗加尔之围:苏丹吉亚特·丁·图格卢克派遣一支由他儿子穆罕默德·本·图克卢克所率领的远征军去卡卡蒂亚首都瓦朗加尔 — — 在统治者普拉塔帕鲁德拉拒绝支付贡品后. 他包围了这座城市,最后经过了8个月的竞选,普拉塔帕鲁德拉于11月9日投降.
de: Siege of Warangal: Sultan Ghiyath al-Din Tughluq sends an expeditionary army led by his son, Muhammad bin Tughluq, to the Kakatiya capital Warangal – after ruler Prataparudra has refused to make tribute payments. He besieges the city and finally, after a campaign of 8 months, Prataparudra surrenders on November 9.

t: 瑞典与诺夫哥罗德共和国签订"诺特堡条约",首次规范了两国边界.
te: The Treaty of Nöteborg between Sweden and Novgorod Republic is signed, regulating the border between the two countries …
dz: 瑞典与诺夫哥罗德共和国签订"诺特堡条约",首次规范了两国边界.
de: The Treaty of Nöteborg between Sweden and Novgorod Republic is signed, regulating the border between the two countries for the first time.

t: 普拉塔帕鲁德拉向穆罕默德·本·图格拉克投降,正式标志着卡卡蒂亚王朝的终结.
te: Prataparudra surrenders to Muhammad bin Tughlaq, officially marking the end of the Kakatiya dynasty.
dz: 围攻瓦朗加尔:普拉塔帕鲁德拉向穆罕默德·本·图格拉克投降,正式标志着卡卡蒂亚王朝的终结.
de: Siege of Warangal: Prataparudra surrenders to Muhammad bin Tughlaq, officially marking the end of the Kakatiya dynasty.
